JSW's First SUV Set for Launch, Details Emerge

JSW is preparing to launch its first SUV, with interest registrations now open. While specific pricing and delivery details remain undisclosed, the vehicle is anticipated to feature 360hp power and a range of 1100 km, along with a distinctive "boxy" design. The official entry is slated for December 4.
